notice: Independent research review only; never an eo-lifecycle-review/v1 certification.
rationale: Independent reading: held EO 11979 (42 FR 16771, Mar. 28, 1977) is a single amendment re-wording sec. 1(b) of EO 11832 (Commission on the Observance of International Women's Year) to 45 members; no own term or other section. Held EO 11980 (Mar. 29, 1977) further amends the same sec. 1(b) to 42 members. Held EO 12050 (43 FR 14431, Apr. 4, 1978) sec. 8: 'Executive Order No. 11126, as amended, and Executive Order No. 11832, as amended, are revoked'. The parent 'as amended' revocation removes the only text EO 11979 put in place; independent status NO, agrees. Refutation: EO 11979 is not named in EO 12050 (whole_via_parent); the producer says so and relies on parent-as-amended wording, which carries the amendment with it. D6: EO 11980 (before the revocation) changed the figure, not a revival; nothing after 1978 names EO 11979 or re-creates the Commission in the held corpus; an earlier end of the Commission (if any) would only move the NO earlier. Nothing ignored. Accept.
